name: Tumbling Opportunist
text:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements Your most recent action was to Tumble Through or Tumbling Strike, and you successfully moved through an enemy's space.

---
You use a burst of stamina to perform a breathtaking feat of Acrobatics as you speed through a foe's space, leaving your foe lying flat on their back. You attempt to trip the enemy whose space you moved through. You can use Acrobatics (trip skill=acrobatics) instead of Athletics for this check.
